verdict.rationale: Homebrew's core product is a CLI that installs and runs on the user's own macOS, Linux or WSL machine, including under non-admin accounts (homebrew-docs-27, -44, -53). Its source is on GitHub (homebrew-gh-1). Users can also host their own package repositories: taps accept any Git URL (homebrew-docs-60, -19), and taps can build and serve their own bottles (homebrew-docs-57, -58). A hands-on report says hosting a tap requires running a git server rather than putting it behind a simple CDN (homebrew-comm-16). Missing for 10: documented mirroring of homebrew-core, bottle and formulae-API infrastructure; explicit open-source license evidence; an easier static-hosting path for taps.
